//: The renderer's own scripts, in the only order that works.
This list used to live in ui/index.html as 25 <script> tags. The page now loads
one bundle (ui/renderer.js, built by ui/build-renderer.js from this list) and the
order lives here instead, where the build and every test read the same copy.
prefix   — bundled FIRST, before app.js: the host bridge. It is not part of the
renderer's module list (tests/harness.js uiModules leaves it out), but
the page must run it before anything touches window.clutch.
modules  — the renderer, in page order (tests/harness.js uiSource() joins these).
separate — sits in `modules` (same position for the source readers) but keeps its
own <script> tag: ui/version.js is a generated DATA file, rewritten by
the release scripts after the bundle exists, and nothing may read it
at load time (the About pane reads it when it is opened).
